titles.title: สัมพันธ์รักขังใจ

description:
“Do you still like sweets?”    
“… Do your tastes change easily?” 

“Then do you still like mine?” 

Her hair stood on end at the clear provocation. Fortunately, there were only two of them in the elevator, but this wasn’t a joke to laugh off. 

“Let’s roll around again like we did back then. Rough and dirty. That’s what I came here for.”
